replacements.La diferencia no es que una RNN “no pued: The difference is not that an RNN ‘cannot remember’ while a Transformer can. It is the geometry of computation: a recurrent network propagates state step by step; self-attention can connect two known positions within one layer and process those positions in parallel.
replacements.Comparación entre una red recurrente que: Comparison between a recurrent network that propagates state sequentially and a self-attention layer that connects positions directly and processes known positions in parallel

replacements.una relación distante no necesita atrave: a distant relationship does not need to traverse a chain of recurrent states within the layer
replacements.la atención densa compara pares de posic: dense attention compares pairs of positions: it gains parallelism and a short path, but introduces the n × n matrix explained in the next section
replacements.Esto describe el cómputo dentro de una c: This describes computation within a layer over positions that are already known. An autoregressive decoder still generates new tokens sequentially: token t+1 does not exist until t has been chosen.
